purpose: True console mode (--headless) so behavior generation runs through MO2's VFS with no window and no user involvement; stock 4.4.0-beta always creates a MainWindow (issue #128).

source.upstreamHeadlessWork: None. Issue #114 (execution without GUI) closed by adding --auto_run, which still creates the window; preview branch (64 commits ahead, new patch format) renames projects but keeps the same Avalonia WinExe entry; no CLI/headless PR or branch exists.

build.publish: dotnet publish -c Release -r win-x64 --self-contained true -p:PublishSingleFile=true -p:IncludeAllContentForSelfExtract=true (mirrors upstream release.yaml)
build.warnings: pre-existing upstream nullability warnings only, 0 errors

diff.behavior: --headless runs the engine once with no Avalonia lifetime, no window; UI log lines stream to stdout; Engine.log written to the -o output folder; exit 0 success, 1 engine failure, 2 fatal. -o is wired to IPathSettings.SetOutputFolder in the headless path (dead in stock 4.4.0 despite being parsed). GUI path unchanged.
diff.upstreamable: Yes - small additive diff on upstream style; user decides whether to PR.

usage: toolsun-pandora.cmd, or: MO2Headless.exe --root <instance> --timeout 3600 run <exe> --arguments '--headless -o "<output mod>"'
rebuild: git clone -b ensrick/headless https://github.com/Ensrick/pandora-behaviour-engine (local: C:/Users/danjo/source/repos/pandora-behaviour-engine); git submodule update --init --recursive; dotnet publish as above with a .NET 10 SDK.

recipe.where: ledger row 'Pandora Output - Ensrick', recipe field (kind: tool): input aggregates (Pandora_Engine templates, the sppffp/sppftp Nemesis patch folders as the VFS sees them, the XPMSSE FNIS list + animations) with the vendor archive hashes, the run command, and the SHA-256 of every payload output file.
